title: Page 3
lines: 摇曳的烛火没有回答他，似水的静夜也不理睬他的旁徨，任由他像只掉进蛛网苦苦挣扎的小虫，被牢牢沾黏在蛛网上，不知该怎么挣扎，不知该怎么去排解心头那份由巨大伤痛所成的懊悔，他不知该怎么去面对，他那已被毁于他人之手的小妹。
大哥斐思年曾经在他久伤不癒，且病情一日日加重时，坐在他的床畔，以一种同样身为加害者的怜悯目光看着他，并哑声对他道。
“自责是一种罪，而这罪愆，却不是你想赎就能赎的，唯今咱们所能做的，就是不要辜负，然后坚强的活下去……”
马车不知是在何时停止了，前来开门的知书躬着身，站在车门外恭谨地为他
“三爷。”
斐然倏地将心思自回忆中拉离远走，二话不说地步下马车，走向今夜将暂宿的客栈，只是在来到客栈大堂时，另一名贴身小厮达礼已来到他身后站定。
“何事？”无视于大堂中认出皇爷府马车也认出他身分的众人，正对着他在四下窃窃私语，多年来行走江湖早已将此景视之理所当然的他，淡淡问向身后。
“南济城城主拜帖。”达礼连忙双手奉上一张刚抵他手中新鲜出炉的拜帖。
拜帖？斐然不悦地拢起两眉。
他前脚才抵这座南济城，投宿的地方也才刚到步，这下就有拜帖了？该说是拜帖的主人太过积极，将他的行踪打探得不错分毫，还是该说这拜帖的主人老早就在暗中注意他许久，所以才如此迫不及待？
“城主明晚设宴为其爱女过寿，邀您过府一叙。”眼看斐然对手中的拜帖看也不看，达礼只好轻声道出帖中内容。
“推了。”
达礼不疾不徐地勾回他的心思，“三爷有所不知，这位南济城城主府中门客甚多，咱们要找的那个人，听说……与府里的某位门人交情不浅，数月前还曾一块儿喝过酒。”
斐然猛然转过身，“这消息是打哪来的？”
“文家大少免费奉送的。”达礼小心翼翼地看着他的脸庞，“说是看在那两张魂纸三爷给得那么痛快的份上。”身为生意人典范的文家大少，听说做生意的一贯理念就是与人为善，不但顾全了主客双方的颜面，也很聪明的保住了日后往来的机会。
文家大少这四字一入耳，斐然登时胸口就有股吐不出也咽不下的郁闷之气。都说商人重利投机，行走各国多年，他还真没见过比文谨这位大少爷更懂得坑人也懂得在挖人好处之余，却不忘留好在日后相见的后路……只是那位文家大少难道会不知道，与这个免费奉送的消息相比，当时他以两张魂纸为代价所买来的消息，顿时就显得一点也微不足道？
“三爷？”还等着他答覆的达礼，有些害怕地看着向来在人前总戴着假面具的自家三爷，被气得差点就维持不住一贯温文有礼的假象。
他咬牙道：“挑份寿礼，明晚与宴。”
遭人暗坑还得感谢这恩惠的斐然，一迳暗生着闷气，跟在他身边的知书，则是如临大敌般地赶紧将他给领去了客房，而达礼则是趁此机会联络手下去部署明晚与宴之事，早已做惯这事的他，连想也不必想，明晚在有了原国皇爷府然公子与宴的寿辰宴，又将是如何老套的一种场景。
事实上，一如达礼先前所料，在次日斐然带着他俩光临城主府时，迎接他们的，除了在场与宴者满面惊喜与讶然外，宴会席上，就属那位主办这场寿宴的南济城城主周漕雁脸上的笑容最是刺眼。
很不耐烦来这种场合却又不得不来的斐然，在漾着假笑打发了一波波前来拉拢关系、或赶着来攀亲搭戚的宾客后，方才落坐欣赏台上伶人们的歌舞不久，他就感受到一道火辣辣的目光。
台上吊着嗓子唱着江南小调的伶人们不知是何时散去了，取而代之的，是一个个衣衫轻薄、身材姣好，令台下众人两眼放光的舞姬。
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
那女人是怕恶心不到他不成？她也不想想，她还是个未出阁的闺女，居然半点闺誉也不顾，就这么大剌剌地在此等场合以贪婪的目光瞪着他瞧。君不见坐在她身旁周遭的贵妇们，此刻都蹙着眉巴不得坐离她远点了，可她却像看不见四下反应似的，仍是一迳地以想要将他生吞活剥的目光看着他。
“南济城民风如此令人作呕？”斐然恹恹地扔下了手中洁白的象牙筷，席间本就没进什么吃食的他这下更是没半点食慾了。
知书皮笑肉不笑地说着，“还不都是某位城主给纵出来的？”敢打他家三爷的主意？那位自以为高高在上的城主小姐，她太不了解他家表里完全不一的三爷是有多洁癖兼小心眼了。
“听说这位城主大人近来与西苑国走得很近？”斐然转眼看向席间南济与宴的众官员，只见他们不但对台上香艳得踰矩的歌舞全然习以为常，还各自左拥右抱一名歌姬或舞姬，堂而皇之的在他这名皇爷府出身的然公子面前恣情纵乐。
知书以看死人的目光缓缓看向席间的宾客，“不仅如此，西苑国朝中似乎还有人为他疏通一二。”
“他打算叛了我原国？”
“据探子回报，至今仍找不到确切证据。”不过，在今晚过后，或许就连什么证据也都不需要了。
早在开席前就去打点一切的达礼，在斐然就要捺不住性子想走人时，悄悄来到他的身后低声禀报，而一旁的知书则是在斐然拿起桌上的酒杯欲饮时，连忙一掌按下他的手。
“三爷。”知书皱眉地瞪着他。
斐然不以为意地拨开他的手，举起手中明显掺了好料的酒杯晃了晃，泛着琥珀色的酒液在酒杯中旋了一圈又一圈，在大厅众多的烛光下旋转成一种妩媚诱惑的色泽。
他仰首一饮而尽，而后气定神闲地道：“既然都已把主意打到我头上来了，何不就做回好事成全了他们？”
知书阴沉着一张脸，不动声色地将眼角余光扫向对面周菲之处，乍见她一脸得逞后志得意满翩然退席的模样，他缓缓握紧了两拳。
“我这就去安排。”正愁找不到个拿他们开刀的藉口，这下什么功夫都可以省了。
于是乎，在斐然的刻意允许下，身为座上嘉宾，且名满天下的原国然公子，理所当然地在席上酒醉，再理所当然地被城主府中殷勤周到的奴仆给扶至客房歇息，而然公子的随侍们，则是理所当然地被请出客院，代替然公子去应付那些各家宾客派来打探情况的小厮。
夜未深，人未静，城主府大厅处的舞姬们，依旧翩翩起舞勾引起一派活色生香，城主府的客院里，则是安静得像是一种无言的诱惑。
将随身的丫头与婆子留在客房外后，周菲推开客房的门扇悄声入内，再将房门密密掩上，图谋此刻许久的她，定眼看着正躺在床榻上合着眼不断喘息，面上还泛着不正常红晕的斐然。
什么名满天下质若美玉的然公子？还以为有多难弄到手呢，几杯黄汤下肚后，不也照样被她手到擒来？
踩着得意的脚步来到床畔，周菲在看似难受得紧的斐然身旁坐下，低首看着他这张不知迷惑了各国多少佳人芳心的脸庞，她得意地勾扬起唇角。

The flickering candlelight didn't answer him, and the watery stillness of the night ignored his hesitation, leaving him like a struggling bug stuck in a spider's web. He didn't know how to struggle, he didn't know how to deal with the regret caused by the huge pain in his heart, and he didn't know how to face his little sister who had been destroyed at the hands of others.
The eldest brother, Feisinian, once sat beside his bed when he was injured for a long time and his condition worsened day by day. He looked at him with the same pity as a perpetrator and said to him in a mute voice.
"Self-blame is a sin, and this sin cannot be redeemed if you want to. But all we can do now is not to live up to it, and then live strong..."
The carriage stopped at some point. Zhishu, who came to open the door, bowed and stood outside the carriage door respectfully.
"Third Master."
Fei Ran quickly pulled his thoughts away from his memories, got out of the carriage without saying a word, and walked towards the inn where he would stay tonight. However, when he arrived at the inn lobby, another valet had already arrived and stood behind him.
"What's the matter?" Ignoring the people in the lobby who recognized the Emperor's carriage and recognized his identity, they were whispering to him. He, who had long taken this scene for granted after traveling in the world for many years, asked quietly behind him.
"A greeting card for the Lord of Nanji City." Da Li quickly handed over a freshly baked greeting card that had just arrived in his hands.
Greetings? Fei Ran raised his eyebrows in displeasure.
He has just arrived at Nanji City, and he has just arrived at the place where he will stay. Now he has a greeting card? Should it be said that the owner of the invitation was too proactive and had found out his whereabouts very well, or should it be said that the owner of the invitation had been secretly paying attention to him for a long time, so he was so impatient?
"The city lord is hosting a banquet for his beloved daughter's birthday tomorrow night, and invites you to visit her." Seeing that Fei Ran didn't even look at the greeting card in his hand, Da Li could only whisper the content.
"Pushed."
Da Li calmly recalled his thoughts, "Third Master, I don't know something. This Nanji City Lord's mansion has many guests. The person we are looking for, I heard... has a close friendship with a certain disciple in the mansion, and we even had a drink together a few months ago."
Feiran turned around suddenly, "Where did this news come from?"
"The young master of the Wen family gave it to him for free." Da Li looked at his face carefully, "It's because the third master gave the two soul papers so happily." As a model businessman, the young master of the Wen family heard that his consistent philosophy in doing business is to be kind to others.
As soon as the words "young master of the Wen family" came into his ears, Fei Ran immediately felt a feeling of depression in his chest that he couldn't spit out or swallow. It is said that businessmen value profit and speculate, and they have traveled around the world for many years. He has never seen anyone who knows how to deceive people better than Wen Jin, who knows how to poach people for their own benefits, but does not forget to leave a way for them to meet in the future... But doesn't the young man of the Wen family know that compared with the free news, the news he bought at the cost of two soul papers suddenly seemed insignificant?
"Third Master?" Da Li, who was still waiting for his answer, looked at his Third Master with some fear, who always wore a mask in front of others, and was so angry that he almost couldn't maintain the illusion of being always gentle and polite.
He gritted his teeth and said, "Choose a birthday gift and have a banquet tomorrow night."
"Yes."
He had to be grateful for the grace after being cheated. Yi Yi was sulking secretly. Zhi Shu who was following him quickly led him to the guest room as if facing a formidable enemy. Da Li took this opportunity to contact his subordinates to arrange things for tomorrow night and Yan. Being used to this, he didn't even have to think about how old-fashioned the scene would be tomorrow night for the birthday banquet of Prince Fu Ran and Yan, the prince of the original country.
In fact, just as Da Li had expected, when Fei Ran brought them to the city lord's palace the next day, they were greeted with surprises and astonishment on the faces of the guests present and at the banquet. At the banquet, the lord of Nanji City, Zhou Caoyan, who hosted the birthday banquet, had the most dazzling smile on his face.
Fei Ran was very impatient to come to such an occasion but had to come. After dismissing waves of guests with a fake smile who came to make friends or come to meet relatives, he just sat down to enjoy the singing and dancing of the actors on the stage. Not long after, he felt a burning gaze.
The performers on the stage singing Jiangnan tunes disappeared at some point, and were replaced by dancers with thin clothes and good figures who made everyone in the audience shine.
[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]
Is that woman afraid that she won't be able to disgust him? She also didn't want to think about it, that she was still a girl who had not left the court, and she didn't care about her reputation at all, so she glared at him with greedy eyes on such occasions. You can see that the ladies sitting next to her were all frowning and wishing they could sit farther away from her, but she seemed to be unable to see the reaction, still looking at him with eyes that wanted to devour him alive.
"Nanji City's folk customs are so disgusting?" Fei Ran threw down the white ivory chopsticks in his hand. He had not eaten anything during the dinner and now he had no appetite at all.
Zhi Shupi said with a smile, "Aren't they all manipulated by a certain city lord?" Dare you take advantage of his third master? The lady of the city lord who thinks she is superior, she doesn't understand how mysophobic and petty the third master of his family is.
"I heard that the Lord of the City has been very close to the Xiyuan Kingdom recently?" Fei Ran turned his eyes and looked at Nanji and the officials at the banquet. He saw that not only were they completely accustomed to the overly fragrant singing and dancing on the stage, but they also each hugged a singer or dancer on the left and right, openly reveling in front of him, the Prince Ran, who was born in the Imperial Palace.
Zhishu slowly looked at the guests at the banquet with the eyes of a dead person, "Not only that, there seems to be someone in the Xiyuan Kingdom who is trying to smooth things over for him."
"He plans to rebel against my original country?"
"According to the spies' report, no definite evidence has been found so far." However, after tonight, perhaps no evidence will be needed.
Da Li, who had gone to prepare everything before the banquet started, just when Feiran couldn't hold back his temper and wanted to leave, quietly came behind him and reported in a low voice, while Zhishu on the side quickly pressed down Feiran's hand when he picked up the wine glass on the table and wanted to drink.
"Third Master." Zhishu glared at him with a frown.
Fei Ran brushed his hand away nonchalantly, raised the wine glass in his hand that was obviously mixed with good ingredients and shook it. The amber liquid swirled around and around in the glass, turning into a charming and seductive color under the many candlelights in the hall.
He raised his head and drank it all in one gulp, and then calmly said: "Since you have already set your sights on me, why not do something good and make them happy?"
Zhishu had a gloomy face and calmly glanced at Zhou Fei across the way from the corner of his eye. When he saw her triumphant look on her face as she walked away from the table, he slowly clenched his fists.
"I'll make arrangements right away." Zhengchou couldn't find an excuse to attack them, so now he could save any effort.
So, with Fei Ran's deliberate permission, as a guest at the table and famous all over the world, Young Master Yuan Guoran got drunk at the table as a matter of course, and was helped to the guest room to rest by the attentive and thoughtful servants of the city lord's palace. However, Young Master Ran's attendants were naturally invited out of the guest house to replace Young Master Ran to deal with the servants sent by various guests to inquire about the situation.
It was late at night and people were still quiet. The dancers in the lobby of the City Lord's Mansion were still dancing gracefully, causing a lively scene. In the guest courtyard of the City Lord's Mansion, it was as quiet as a silent temptation.
After leaving the girl and mother-in-law with her outside the guest room, Zhou Fei pushed open the door of the guest room and quietly entered, then closed the door tightly. She had been plotting for a long time and looked at Fei Ran who was lying on the bed with her eyes closed and panting, with an abnormal blush on her face.
What is Mr. Ran who is famous all over the world and is as good as jade? I thought it would be so difficult to get it, but after drinking several cups of yellow soup, wouldn’t it still be easy for her to get it?
Walking proudly to the bedside, Zhou Fei sat down next to Fei Ran who seemed to be uncomfortable. She lowered her head and looked at his face that had attracted the hearts of so many beauties from all over the world. She raised the corners of her lips proudly.
